title: Dashboard: list of held positions currently flagged to sell
description: User request: the dashboard should also show a list of tickers with a sell flag. GET /api/portfolio/risk already returns exit_flags per held position (docs/Analyse.md's 'Existing-position exit signals' section -- e.g. 'stop_hit', 'tide_flipped_bearish') -- RiskSummaryCard currently condenses this to an aggregate count only ('Positions Breaching 2% Rule'), not a per-ticker list. The simplest correct implementation is a new dashboard component listing every position with a non-empty exit_flags (data already available, no backend change needed). Decide and record as a decisions entry whether 'sell flag' should ALSO include a position whose fresh technical signal (GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis) is SELL -- Analyse.md distinguishes fresh technical SELL from risk-driven exit flags as related but separate concepts -- and if so, how to get that per held position without an N+1 call pattern (may require a backend follow-up task rather than being done here); the risk-driven exit_flags list alone is a complete, independently useful implementation of this task even if that extension is deferred.

checklist.step: Decide the scope of 'sell flag' (risk-driven exit_flags only, vs. also fresh technical SELL) and record as a decisions entry, including whether any backend follow-up task is needed for the fresh-signal case.

Add a new component (e.g. SellFlaggedPositionsCard) listing every position from usePortfolioRisk with a non-empty exit_flags, showing the ticker and which flag(s) fired -- reuse DataTable/existing common/ components rather than a bespoke table.
Compose it into DashboardPage.tsx alongside the existing RiskSummaryCard/PositionsGlanceTable.
Handle the empty case (no positions currently flagged) with EmptyState or an inline message, not a blank gap.
Tests: component test(s) for the flagged-list rendering (including the empty case), MSW-mocked; confirm 90% coverage gate still holds and Storybook covers any new common/ component.
